reviews.title: Great card for SFF cases!
reviews.comment: Bought for $1100 before the gpu shortages and 50 series launch. Looking back, i felt i over payed but now it seems like great value seeing the current state of the market. It’s an SFF card so it gets slightly more toasty than cards with larger heat sinks but it performs just as good.
reviews.author: Calvin

reviews.title: Powerful
reviews.comment: I recently upgraded my PC with the ASUS ProArt GeForce RTX 4080 Super, and it's been fantastic for video editing. The performance is impressive, making complex edits and rendering smooth and fast. It handles high-resolution footage and effects effortlessly, which is a huge plus for my workflow. The build quality and design are top-notch, fitting seamlessly into my setup. Overall, it's a great product that significantly boosts my editing capabilities. The only drawback is the price—it’s a bit on the expensive side. However, the performance and quality make it a worthwhile investment if you're serious about video editing. Highly recommended for professionals who need powerful graphics.
reviews.author: Nikoloz

reviews.title: MUST BUY 40 SERIES CARD!
reviews.comment: This card handles anything that I can throw at it. 16GB Memory gives you plenty of room to run multiple instances and render. Multiple editing apps? No problem. Gaming while running streaming/recording software? Ez. It comes OC'd but handles further OCing with no issues. Boosted to 2800Mhz gpu clock with 25000Mhz memory clock with GT3. It runs smooth even with high fan usage, as other reviews mentioned it might be louder than other models, I do not notice it over the rest of my fans. Much easier installation than RTX3080 as well.
reviews.author: Tone Martinez

reviews.title: Small and powerful GPU
reviews.comment: Premium price tag, but comes with the benefit of solid performance in real world applications as well as synthetic benchmarking. Another plus is that its a smaller card in comparison to other 40 series GPUs which gives you more freedom when it comes to fitting it in even some mini ITX cases. I currently have it in a coolermaster NR200P and the clearance is just right. Also great for those who are looking into minimalist or "stealth" builds without RGB.
reviews.author: Daniel

reviews.title: Solid equipment
reviews.comment: Very impressed with how this compares to NVIDIA. This was a solid price point at solid performance.
